candidate_ideas.statement: For every g≥2 and odd r, H^{4g-3}(M_{g,1};H^{⊗r})=0 (equivalently the Steinberg coinvariants (St_g⊗H_Q^{⊗r})_{G_{g,1}} vanish).

A nontrivial cyclic generator φ_0 of St_g as a Q[G_{g,1}]-module is fixed by each handle half-turn τ_i (or has controlled sign under τ_i), and each τ_i acts as −1 on the i-th symplectic plane of H_Q and as +1 on the complementary planes, so that every odd-degree pure tensor is killed in the coinvariants.
W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0, hence W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is the empty direct sum of Q(8).

Chord-slide relations on one-filling systems reduce every oriented zero-filling system to a mapping-class translate of a single nontrivial 0-filling system, yielding cyclicity of St_g as a Q[G_{g,1}]-module on that generator.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0001 together with the packet exact-target dictionary (poincaré_twist 21, ordinary degree 26, open BM degree 16).
established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, the open Borel–Moore input W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q) is identified by Poincaré duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d). For (g,n)=(6,6) one has d=21, so W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)=W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21).

established_facts.evidence: Packet FND-0036 records vcd(M_{6,5})=25; the uniform formula d_j=4g-4+j for g=6 is the standard Harer vcd used throughout the observable argument.
established_facts.statement: The virtual cohomological dimension of M_{6,j} is vcd(M_{6,j})=4·6-4+j=20+j. In particular vcd(M_{6,1})=21, vcd(M_{6,5})=25, and vcd(M_{6,6})=26.

For the forgetful map M_{6,6}→M_{6,5}, the q=0 Leray term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; fibre cohomology occurs only in degrees q=0,1, and no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument equations (4)–(5); diagnostics confirm the residue SES as a short exact sequence of VMHS.
established_facts.statement: Let H be the rank-12 weight-one symplectic local system R^1 of the universal closed genus-6 curve, write V_r=H^{⊗r} with V_0=Q, and let f_j:M_{6,j}→M_{6,j-1} forget the j-th mark. The fibre is a genus-6 curve with j-1 punctures and has cohomology only in degrees 0 and 1. The residue exact sequence of mixed Hodge modules 0→H→R_j→Q(-1)^{j-2}→0 holds for R_j=R^1(f_j)_*Q, and tensoring with V_r yields 0→V_{r+1}→V_r⊗R_j→V_r(-1)^{j-2}→0.

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument equations (6) and the vcd vanishing mechanism of packet FND-0036 applied fibrewise in the forgetful tower.
established_facts.statement: Fix r=6-j for 2≤j≤6. Then d_j+r=26 and d_{j-1}+r+1=26. For coefficients V_r the Leray spectral sequence of f_j has only rows q=0,1; the q=0 term H^{d_j}(M_{6,j-1};V_r) vanishes by the vcd of the base; R^2(f_j)_*Q=0 so no differential enters E_2^{d_{j-1},1}, and outgoing differentials land above d_{j-1}. Hence there is an isomorphism of mixed Hodge structures H^{d_j}(M_{6,j};V_r)≅H^{d_{j-1}}(M_{6,j-1};V_r⊗R_j).

established_facts.evidence: Observable weight arithmetic: with r=6-j one has d_{j-1}=19+j and d_{j-1}+r+2=(19+j)+(6-j)+2=27 uniformly for each stage j=2,…,6.
established_facts.statement: The residue quotient coefficient V_r(-1) is pure of weight r+2. Cohomology in degree d_{j-1} with that coefficient has weight floor d_{j-1}+r+2=27. Consequently Gr^W_{26} H^{d_{j-1}}(M_{6,j-1};V_r(-1)^{j-2})=0.

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument equations (7)–(8); diagnostics confirm that connecting maps from Gr^W_{26} of the weight-two quotient in degree d_{j-1}-1 alter kernels rather than cokernels once the same-degree graded piece of the residue quotient vanishes.
established_facts.statement: Morphisms of mixed Hodge structures are strict for the weight filtration. Applying Gr^W_{26} to the long exact sequence of 0→V_{r+1}→V_r⊗R_j→V_r(-1)^{j-2}→0 and using vanishing of the residue quotient on Gr^W_{26} yields a surjection Gr^W_{26} H^{d_{j-1}}(M_{6,j-1};V_{r+1})↠Gr^W_{26} H^{d_{j-1}}(M_{6,j-1};V_r⊗R_j). Combined with the Leray isomorphism this gives, for each j=2,…,6, that Gr^W_{26} H^{d_j}(M_{6,j};V_{6-j}) is a quotient of Gr^W_{26} H^{d_{j-1}}(M_{6,j-1};V_{7-j}).

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument equation (9) as the formal composite of the five stagewise quotient maps.
established_facts.statement: Composing the five Gr^W_{26} surjections for j=6,5,4,3,2 yields a surjection Gr^W_{26} H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5})↠Gr^W_{26} H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q).

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument equations (10)–(11) and the final duality conversion; the implication is conditional on source vanishing.
established_facts.statement: On a smooth Deligne–Mumford stack with constant Q coefficients, H^{26} has weights at least 26, so W_{26}H^{26}=Gr^W_{26}H^{26} in that degree. Therefore vanishing of the source of the composite surjection would imply W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0, and by Poincaré duality the exact Borel–Moore group would be zero (the empty direct sum of Q(8)).

established_facts.evidence: Observable argument section 1 (Harer virtual-duality identification of the top-degree group with Steinberg coinvariants).
established_facts.statement: Harer virtual duality identifies the top-degree rational cohomology of the pure mapping class group G_{g,1} with Steinberg coinvariants: H^{4g-3}(G_{g,1};H_Q^{⊗r})≅H_0(G_{g,1};St_g⊗H_Q^{⊗r}), where St_g is the top reduced homology of the curve complex. Over Q the orbifold cohomology of M_{g,1} agrees with group cohomology after passage to a torsion-free finite-index subgroup and averaging.

R^1π_*Q for the universal n-punctured curve is mixed of weights 1 and 2 (an extension of a rank n-1 Tate system of weight 2 by the rank 2g weight-1 system), never pure of weight 1; the correct weight floor for H^p(base;L) is therefore ≥p+1.

The RED-0001 corner W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) is a pure polarizable Q-Hodge structure of weight −16; polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of fixed weight form a semisimple abelian category, so any subquotient of a direct sum of Tate objects in that row is again a direct sum of the same Tate object.

established_facts.evidence: Packet adjudicated finding FND-0035 (ordinary degree equals vcd for (6,6)).
established_facts.statement: For (g,n)=(6,6) the required ordinary degree 2d−16 equals the virtual cohomological dimension, so vanishing theorems for degrees strictly above vcd do not by themselves resolve the exact target on M_{6,6}.

established_facts.evidence: Packet primary locator SRC-0004, Lemma 10.6 degree/Serre-duality calculation.
established_facts.statement: By SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, for W_{f_i}=O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O(−f_i) one has deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=4g+12−4f_i, and the CE obstruction degree is deg(ω_C⊗W_{f_i}^∨(Γ))=4f_i+n−2g−14.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The standard ordered 0-filling system represents the zero class in the Steinberg module St_g. Cyclicity of St_g uses a different nontrivial generator φ_0. With s=0 the identity τ_i s=s is vacuous and supplies no information about the coinvariants (St_g⊗H_Q^{⊗r})_{G_{g,1}}.
invalid_steps.statement: Take s to be the class in St_g of the standard ordered 0-filling system A={a_1,b_1,…,a_g,b_g} (standard 4g-gon side identification), assert that s generates St_g as a Q[G_{g,1}]-module, and deduce τ_i s=s for handle half-turns because those half-turns fix the unoriented arcs of A.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Because [A]=0 in St_g, a reduction of every filling system to a G-translate of A cannot prove that St_g is cyclic on [A]; at best it reconfirms that degenerate or standard systems contribute the zero class, not a cyclic generator.
invalid_steps.statement: From the cellular presentation of filling systems, chord-slide relations and lexicographic reduction of intersections show that every oriented zero-filling system is congruent to a mapping-class translate of the standard system A, hence s=[A] generates St_g.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The half-turn coinvariance identity is applied to the zero class s=[A] in St_g, so the sign flip on odd tensors never sees a nontrivial Steinberg factor. The resulting vanishing of (St_g⊗H^{⊗5})_G and of H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5}) is not established by this argument.
invalid_steps.statement: For every basis pure tensor t of odd degree r some symplectic plane H_i occurs oddly often, so τ_i t=−t; combined with [s⊗v]=[s⊗τ_i v] and s=[A] this forces all coinvariants of St_g⊗H_Q^{⊗r} to vanish, and therefore H^{4g-3}(G_{g,1};H_Q^{⊗r})=0 and H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5})=0.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The composite surjection is only a conditional reduction: its source vanishing is not proved by the standard-filling-system argument, so the implication does not establish vanishing of the exact lowest-weight group.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: A proof that H^{21}(M_{6,1};H^{⊗5})=0, equivalently that the coinvariants (St_6⊗H_Q^{⊗5})_{G_{6,1}} vanish, using a nontrivial cyclic generator of the Steinberg module rather than the zero class of the standard filling system.

Control of the action of each handle half-turn τ_i on a genuine Broaddus cyclic generator φ_0 of St_g (fixedness or sign on St_g, and the standard −1/+1 action on the symplectic summands of H_Q) sufficient to kill all odd-degree pure tensors in the coinvariants.

An independent justification that the odd-tensor top-degree vanishing, once correctly established, upgrades the conditional Gr^W_{26} surjection tower to an unconditional proof that W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=0 (equivalently that the exact Borel–Moore group is a direct sum of Q(8)).

If a geometry-supported route is used instead of the forgetful tower, the residual tetragonal package remains open: construction and scheme-theoretic identification of the CE evaluation-failure locus Z for the balanced splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5), h^0-stratification of the relative degree-six linear system, and component/dimension/stabilizer analysis needed for Tate support in codimension 13.
